title: dep-scan mcp list_components input
description: The arguments the list_components tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: a scan directory and the page controls. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an unknown argument is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

scan_dir.description: The scan directory whose BOM components are listed, as an absolute path. The tool refuses a path that does not resolve, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.

cursor.description: The opaque page cursor a previous call returned as nextCursor. The cursor is the base64url encoding of the page offset; a value the server cannot decode is a tool error.

limit.description: The maximum number of components on the page. The default is 50 and the maximum 200; a larger value is a tool error.
